decision.explanation: Each source explicitly states the location of a distinct entity named 'Abingdon High School': D1S1 refers to Abingdon-Avon High School in Abingdon, Illinois; D2S1 refers to Abingdon High School in Abingdon, Virginia; and D3S1 refers to Abingdon School in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, England. These are distinct institutions with the same name, so their locations are valid and complementary.
